title: Truchas 2D volume tracking
description: Controls for transporting material volume fractions with the flow solver.

algorithm.description: Volume-tracking algorithm. The simple algorithm transports face fluxes directly; the geometric algorithm reconstructs and transports geometrically bounded material volumes. If omitted, the implementation selects a default based on the material configuration.

cutoff.description: Volume-fraction cutoff used by the tracker. It must be strictly between zero and one; the default is 1.0e-6.

subcycles.description: Number of volume-tracking subcycles per flow time step. The default is four.

material-priority.description: Optional priority ordering for material transport. List every fluid, VOID, and SOLID slot exactly once, using the material or reserved-slot names.
